mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, reducing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, the combination signals an accommodative monetary policy in a recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 QoQ < 0%.
